signal: Incode is raising at up to a $3B valuation, acquired AuthenticID, hit FedRAMP Ready, and partnered with Interac, pushing hard into enterprise and government identity verification.

email.body1:
Kimberly, saw Incode chasing a $3B raise, the AuthenticID acquisition, FedRAMP Ready, and the Interac partnership all landing close together.

Expansion that fast usually puts more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before momentum fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Incode off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kimberly, quick follow-up for Incode.

With new verticals opening up after FedRAMP and AuthenticID, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your team needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kimberly, last bit of proof for Incode.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Incode's reply rate likely compares to other identity and security companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kimberly, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A raise plus an acquisition keeps the whole GTM org heads-down for a while.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your business development motion? I'll tailor it to Incode either way.
